messages:
Maya: Hi team — quick async: we're about to ship a minor change to the chat/completions streaming payload. Can folks confirm the approach?

Sam: TLDR please?

Maya: We're deprecating the `chunk_index` integer (it was noisy and client side ordering should be by arrival + `delta` markers). Replacing with `chunk_id` (string uuid) and adding `sample_rate` header so clients can opt-in to lower-fidelity deltas. See example below.

Oliver: Example payload?

Maya: ```json
{"type":"delta","chunk_id":"6f7a-2b9c","role":"assistant","delta":"world","partial_tokens":42,"final":false}
```

Liam: Nice. What's the compatibility story — will old clients break?

Maya: We plan to keep `chunk_index` in servers for 2 weeks and emit both fields in dual-write mode. Clients reading `chunk_index` continue working. After metric collection and a soft-removal flag, we flip to removal behind feature flag then full removal in 6 weeks.

Sam: Any perf or telemetry changes we should watch?

Maya: Yes: adding `sample_rate` means some requests will stream sparser deltas. We'll emit telemetry: `stream_fidelity` tag (values: full/partial/sparse) and `chunk_id_mismatch` counter. Also watch error 429 spike if clients mis-handle missing index causing retries.

InfraBot: Deploy checklist: staging rollout -> 5% canary on prod -> 25% after 4h -> 100% after 24h if no regressions. Add experiment flag `stream_chunk_v2`.

Oliver: Can we add a lint in convo-schema to prefer string ids? I'll open a tiny PR to fail on numeric-only `chunk_id`.

Maya: Please do. Also need docs snippet for SDKs. @Sam can you review the PR for the dual-write logic? :eyes:

Sam: On it, aim to review within today.

Liam: One small ask — keep `final` boolean semantics unchanged; we rely on it for finalization in the cache codepath.

Maya: Acknowledged. We'll keep `final` and add a deprecation note for `prefetch_kv` param in the same change — plan to replace with `kv_mode: "lazy"|"eager"`.

Oliver: Sounds good. Any rollback plan?

Maya: Rollback is just flipping `stream_chunk_v2` off and reverting canary. Infra will monitor `unit_latency_p50` and `token_cost` during canary.

Sam: LGTM for approach, will add a comment on the PR about an edge-case: missing role field in delta messages — ensure we default to previous turn's role.

Maya: Thanks. If no objections by EOD, we'll cut the PR and start canary tomorrow morning.

Oliver: no objections from me.

Liam: fine here.

Sam: Approved.

Maya: Great, will file PR and tag reviewers. Thanks all :rocket:
